title: Failed stage blocks all re-runs: checkpoint restore keeps the failed stage (new/--from-stage fail immediately)
body: A stage that FAILED makes the project unrecoverable via a normal re-run: execute_pipeline -> _load_checkpoint/_restore_from_checkpoint (core/pipeline_executor.py:718-787) restores the checkpoint and only resets stages left running; a failed stage is kept, so the DAG immediately reports pipeline_failed. Observed: a NEW run of MyToDo failed in 8.1s (pipeline_failed: 1 stages failed) without running any agent. Even selective rerun is clobbered because the checkpoint is restored AFTER run_pipeline.py invalidate_for_rerun. Result: no clean retry path; operators must delete pipeline-state.json.

rcca.root_cause: _restore_from_checkpoint resets only running stages and keeps failed stages; the checkpoint is restored after any selective-rerun invalidation, so a failed stage is never re-run and the pipeline fails on load.
rcca.corrective: Treat a failed stage as re-runnable on an explicit new/continue/from-stage request (reset failed -> pending, or do not restore failed stages), so a retry actually re-executes.
rcca.preventive: Test: a state with a failed stage + a new/from-stage request re-runs that stage instead of failing immediately.
